source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I need a case that accommodates all 3 boards and the 18650 battery, with a cover that has a display cutout; I still need to decide between a 1.5 or 2.9 display. The cover shouldn't include any mounts apart from the display, which should be easy to connect so the case can be put on easily. The base should have mounts for every board and the lipo. I can provide some pictures of the current design. There is also an air intake at the bottom where the sensors are located and an air outlet at the top. For the leds, I can place a semi-transparent plexiglass strip over them, or we could create a grid pattern that allows the light to pass through.

value_updates.display_connection_access: easy to connect while installing the cover
value_updates.base_mounts: mounts for every board and the battery
